reviews.title: Worth every penny!
reviews.comment: I was amazed at the quality of this microphone and the way it processes recordings. I got it mainly to improve sound quality for videos of myself drumming with percussion instruments outside in a park. I used it recently to record a guitarist/singer and myself on a djembe and it came out so great! 10/10 recommend.
reviews.author: Phillip Youngs

reviews.title: Allows for traditional video camera replacement
reviews.comment: Great little mic if you now use your mobile as a video camera in place of the traditional video camera that had great sound quality.  It now means the mobile can be used as a direct replacement
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Makes a huge difference.
reviews.comment: This is a great little mic and makes a huge difference when recording yourself or for whatever.  The sound is far better than simply recording with just your phone's built in mic.  I am very picky about how I sound and I narrate a hugely popular  Disney ride that has been in Walt Disney World for 32 years so I need a professional sound.
reviews.author: Mark S.

reviews.title: Best Microphone I've Ever Had!
reviews.comment: I am absolutely blown away by the sound quality on the MV88 USB-C microphone. It REALLY DOES sound like a recording studio! How is there only one review for this product? It's been absolutely amazing for recording crystal clear audio to get perfect transcriptions for AI. The only minor downside is the app had minor glitches when downloading, where I couldn't access the microphone settings. But after re-downloading the app, that fixed the issue. Overall, the MV88 USB-C is the most useful, versatile, and highest sound quality microphone I've ever had!
reviews.author: Gaston

reviews.title: Simply not worth the cost but nonetheless an excellent mic
reviews.comment: Excellent quality, far better than cheaper models, just can’t justify the cost for the use we give it.
reviews.author: Gil
